keyEvents.text: Goal! Inter Milan 1, Monza 0. Hakan Çalhanoglu (Inter Milan) right footed shot from outside the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Andy Diouf.
Delay in match (Inter Milan).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Inter Milan 1, Monza 1. Gustavo Varela (Monza) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Mathis Mout.
Lautaro Martínez (Inter Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match (Inter Milan).
Delay in match because of an injury Adam Bakoune (Monza).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Hakan Çalhanoglu (Inter Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Inter Milan 1, Monza 1.
Goal! Inter Milan 2, Monza 1. Piotr Zielinski (Inter Milan) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal following a corner.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Ange-Yoan Bonny replaces Lautaro Martínez.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Petar Sucic replaces Hakan Çalhanoglu.
Goal! Inter Milan 3, Monza 1. Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter Milan) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Andy Diouf.
Goal! Inter Milan 4, Monza 1. Yann Bisseck (Inter Milan) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Francesco Pio Esposito.
Eddy Kouadio (Monza) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Monza. Omari Forson replaces Andrea Colpani.
Substitution, Monza. Patrick Cutrone replaces Adam Bakoune.
